plain: Once people aim at a score, the score stops measuring what it used to.
eli5: If you get a sticker for every page read, kids start reading very short pages.
technical: Goodhart (1975), in Strathern's wording: “When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.” In ML: optimisation against a proxy judge exploits its errors (reward hacking; Gao et al. 2022).
